data.title: Bitcoin and ethereum prices today, Friday, September 4, 2026: Bitcoin holding above $81,000 following massive ETF inflows
data.description: Bitcoin opened at $81,271.92 on Friday, September 4, 2026, 5.1% higher than Thursday's opening price. As of 7:21 a.m. ET this morning, the price of bitcoin shifted to $81,240.29.  Ethereum opened at $2,507.70 today, up 4.9% from Thursday's opening price. Ethereum moved to $2,522.14 as of 7:21 a.m. ET.
